home.title: {brandName} — Free Alternative to Google Meet & Zoom | Private Video Calls
home.meta_description: {brandName} is the free alternative to Google Meet & Zoom. No sign-up, no downloads. Start an end-to-end encrypted video call in seconds — private, instant, and works everywhere.
home.og_description: The free, private alternative to Google Meet and Zoom. Start an encrypted video call instantly — no account, no downloads, no tracking.
home.hero_description: One link. No sign-up. No downloads. Your conversation stays between you — every call is end-to-end encrypted, so nobody else can listen in.
home.feature_e2ee_description: Every session is encrypted in transit. Only people in the room can see or hear anything — not even us.
home.feature_no_account_description: Start or join a meeting in seconds. No sign-up, no downloads, no friction. Just share the link.
home.feature_open_source_description: The entire codebase is public. Audit it, fork it, self-host it — transparency is the default.
